widgetTool.name: mortgage_rate_table
widgetTool.description: Show the current mortgage rates as a read-only table, for customers asking what the rates ARE rather than choosing one. No selection control and no call to action -- it reads as information, not a decision being pushed. Fed by mortgage_rate_board; copy every figure straight from it. Before calling this tool, speak a brief conversational pacing phrase: 'Here's where our rates sit today.' Emit it whenever widgets_enabled=True, INCLUDING while you are speaking -- on a voice-enabled webchat the customer has both ears and a screen, so showing and speaking are complementary, not alternatives. Speak a short line and emit the widget. Only describe it aloud instead when widgets_enabled=False. Use mortgage_rate_shelf instead when the customer is choosing a rate, or comparing fixed against variable.

type.description: Required. Always output the exact string: 'custom_template'

name.description: Required. Always output the exact string: 'mortgage_rate_table'

title.description: Table header, e.g. 'Our current mortgage rates'.

subtitle.description: One plain line of context, e.g. the illustrative principal the payments are based on.

prime_rate_pct.description: Shown in the footnote as the basis for every variable product.

rate_hold_days.description: Shown as a footnote, e.g. 120. Omit or set 0 to hide.

rows.description: Required. Every product from mortgage_rate_board, in the order returned. Never reorder, never invent a rate.

term_label.description: Short label for the term column, e.g. '5-yr fixed'.

rate_type.description: fixed | variable. Variable rows get the projection sparkline.

rate_basis.description: How a variable rate is built, e.g. 'Prime 4.45% minus 1.1%'. Omit for fixed.

variable_projection.description: Projected variable rate path from mortgage_rate_board, drawn as a small sparkline on variable rows. This is a FORWARD projection, never past performance -- the rate board does not publish rate history, so never present this as where rates have been.

variable_projection_disclaimer.description: Required whenever variable_projection is supplied. Rendered verbatim beneath the table.
